room-31-15-agent-mqeibdmn-ga3nh7.name: a Brambly Slope
room-31-15-agent-mqeibdmn-ga3nh7.description:
The hillside rises steeply here, choked with tangled brambles and patches
of coarse heather clinging to the rocky soil. Loose stones shift underfoot
on the narrow path winding between the thorns. To the north the slope
descends into dense woodland, while to the south the ridge climbs toward
a more elevated and windswept vantage point.

room-31-25-agent-mqej9377-xzisou.name: a Dense Woodland
room-31-25-agent-mqej9377-xzisou.description:
The trees press close here, their roots gnarled and exposed where the ground
falls away toward the rocky slopes to the west. Ferns and low brambles
carpet the floor between the trunks, and the canopy above filters the light
to a dim, shifting green. The air is still and smells of damp earth and
moss-covered bark.
